args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — summary (Bellwether + companion)
args.body:
- Temperature excursions in cold-chain shipments fell 30% in 2026 among carriers that shared live sensor data with partners.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected/refused loads rather than an actual reduction in spoilage rates.
- Companion piece confirms the trend: pilot programs using this shared-data approach cut claims by roughly 25%.
